summary: Atour Lifestyle Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K on May 13, 2026, reporting its unaudited financial results for the first quarter ended March 31, 2026, and announcing a cash dividend. The filing discloses operational metrics and financial performance, but does not involve any acquisitions, divestitures, strategic reviews, tender offers, going-private transactions, capital returns (beyond a routine dividend), spin-offs, rights offerings, restructuring, liquidations, delistings, issuer tenders, deal terminations, SPACs, or activist campaigns. The management change is not present; the filing is a routine earnings release and dividend announcement. As such, it does not meet the criteria for any special-situations category, making "None" the appropriate classification.
